description.en: Distinct hues for experimental groups and cell classes. Use shapes as well when accessibility matters.
description.zh-CN: 用于实验分组与细胞分类；需要无障碍辨识时同时使用点形。

description.en: Soft fills for bars and large areas; avoid tiny points or thin lines.
description.zh-CN: 适合柱形与大面积填色；避免用于细小散点和细线。

description.en: Three hue pairs, light then dark. Set category order explicitly to match your comparisons.
description.zh-CN: 三组同色深浅配对；请明确类别顺序，使配对与实验比较一致。

description.en: Low-to-high values such as expression or abundance. For signed correlations prefer a diverging palette.
description.zh-CN: 用于表达量、丰度等由低到高的数值；有正负的相关性优先使用发散色。

description.en: Negative–neutral–positive values, including correlation. Colors do not imply significance.
description.zh-CN: 用于负值—中性—正值，如相关性；颜色不代表统计显著性。

description.en: Cool-leading groups with warm accents; use explicit labels for related blue/cyan hues.
description.zh-CN: 冷色为主、暖色强调的分组；蓝青近似色请配合明确标签。

description.en: Plant and ecology categories. Hues do not encode biological function; label each group.
description.zh-CN: 适合植物与生态类别；色相不代表生物功能，请标注每组名称。

description.en: Warm tissue-category accents. Similar red/pink hues need labels; no diagnostic meaning.
description.zh-CN: 适合组织类别的暖调强调；红粉近似色需标签辅助，不表示诊断含义。

description.en: Cool category colors for labeled cell atlases. Similar hues need redundant labels or shapes.
description.zh-CN: 适合带标签的细胞分类图；相近色需标签或点形辅助辨识。

description.en: Floral accents for group comparisons and large marks. Check small-mark contrast on white.
description.zh-CN: 适合分组比较与较大图形的花瓣色调；白底细小元素请核对对比度。

description.en: Deep accents for white-background line and point charts. Use labels for hue discrimination.
description.zh-CN: 适合白底折线与散点的深色强调；色相辨识请结合标签。

description.en: Three light/dark pairs: teal, rose and indigo. Set exact category order; colors imply no treatment role.
description.zh-CN: 青、玫红、靛蓝三组深浅配对；请指定类别顺序，颜色不暗示处理角色。

description.en: Green, grape and orange light/dark pairs. Check category order and avoid tiny pale marks.
description.zh-CN: 绿、葡萄紫、橙三组深浅配对；请核对类别顺序，避免细小浅色元素。

description.en: Light-to-dark magnitude, such as expression or abundance; low values are pale. Not for signed differences.
description.zh-CN: 浅至深表示表达量、丰度等大小，低值为浅色；不适合表示正负差异。
